# Gramlot examples 0.2.3

## Fixes

- `e10` (cards with icons) and `e13` (live Source playground) connect their
  buttons with `connect_onclick` instead of `onclick`, in Python and JavaScript.
  Since `gramlot` 0.2.3 the renderers refuse attributes with the form of a native
  event handler, and both pages stopped at their first render.

## Tests

- A browser job opens `e10` and `e13` in Chromium through the published hosts,
  `gramlot-py-server` for the Python pages and `@gramlot/gramlot-js-server` for
  the JavaScript pages. The release workflow runs it before building.

## Requirements

Unchanged: Python 3.11 or later with `gramlot` 0.2.2 or later; Node.js 22 or
later, or Bun, with `@gramlot/gramlot` 0.2.2 or later.
